title: Hearty Velvety Russian Butter Beans Stew
description: A rich and indulgent Russian dish featuring butter beans in a velvety stew, served in a stone bowl or mason jar.
instructions: Saute the chopped onion, minced garlic, chopped carrot, and chopped celery in olive oil until the vegetables are tender.
Add the soaked and drained butter beans, vegetable broth, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes or until the beans are tender.
Use an immersion blender to puree the stew to a velvety consistency, or allow it to cool and puree it in a blender.
Return the stew to the pot and simmer for an additional 10 minutes to heat it through.
Serve the stew hot in a stone bowl or mason jar, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Allow the stew to cool completely before refrigerating or freezing it for later use.
Reheat the stew gently over low heat, whisking constantly, until it is heated through.
